created_at.title: Created at
created_at.description: This is the date and time, in UTC, at which the redemption was created.

equipment_and_material_cost.title: Equipment and material cost
equipment_and_material_cost.description: The total cost of the equipment and materials purchased as part of a redemption.

installation_cost.description: The installation costs associated with this redemption. To qualify, the installation must be performed by an approved contractor. Also see `is_contractor_eligible`.
installation_cost.title: Installation cost

project_completion_date.title: Project completion date
project_completion_date.description: This is a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD. Time zone is immaterial.

rebate_type.title: Rebate type
rebate_type.description: The HOMES rebates have two distinct options for determining savings and rebate amounts, MODELED vs MEASURED.

rebate_deducted.title: Rebate deducted
rebate_deducted.description: This is the amount that was deducted from the customer's/homeowner's purchase price or invoiced amount for products and/or installation.

oneOf.description: This will be an array of strings explaining how the rebate_amount was calculated.
oneOf.$comment: This is a read-only field, automatically populated by the API in the response.

vendor_id.title: Vendor id
vendor_id.description: This is a unique identifier for a vendor that the state will reimburse in connection with a redemption.

measured_percent_energy_savings.description: The calculated percent measured energy savings where total energy use is first converted to source energy in a manner determined by the state. To avoid an immediate breaking change, this field is currently optional when rebate_type is MEASURED and otherwise not allowed – either this field or measured_post_retrofit_energy_usage_kwh_equivalent must be specified when rebate_type is MEASURED. The behavior starting mid to late January 2025 will be: this field is required for rebate_type MEASURED and otherwise not allowed.

measured_post_retrofit_energy_usage_kwh_.title: Measured post-retrofit energy usage kwh equivalent
measured_post_retrofit_energy_usage_kwh_.description: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use `measured_post_retrofit_site_energy_usages_by_fuel_type` instead. This is the total actual annual energy usage converted to kWh-equivalent for the home or multifamily building post-retrofit - based on normalized utility bill data. This field is used for MEASURED redemptions only.

is_contractor_eligible.description: The contractor is eligible if they are on the state's approved list.
is_contractor_eligible.title: Is contractor eligible

total_rebate_payout.description: The amount rebated to the claimant by the state. Do NOT include any contractor incentive amounts.
total_rebate_payout.title: Total rebate payout
